title: Dimensions of Coil Formers of Transformers, Inductors for use in Telecommunication and electronic equipment
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard specifies the essential dimensions of coil-formers of transformers and inductors, using a square stack of laminations inserted in the bobbin, for the lamination shapes specified below. NOTE — The essential dimensions are those permitting interchangeability in respect of conformance with core sizes and outline dimensions of the completed component.
clause_3_terminology: Dimensions of Coil Formers of Transformers
Inductors for use in Telecommunication and electronic equipment

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
